issue: No observed delivered log price in MERIS.
evidence: tbl_essences_revenus_EssDhp has 1,824 rows but every SCIAGE/PATE value is 0.0100; tbl_Zones_RedevBenefRentSal_F1234 is an economic value decomposition; tbl_770 demo only.
impact: Forest-sector net value cannot be computed from actual MERIS data.
recommended_action: Use BMMB auction/delivered sale records or mill settlements; keep MERIS for stumpage and cost parameters.

issue: Ledger has no quality dimension; QC DER/F1/F2/F3/F4/PATE/AUTRE are distinct rate classes.
evidence: tbl_redevances_F1234 has 7 product columns per species; ledger product enum has only peeler/sawlog/pulpwood/mixed_log.
impact: Only one sawlog quality can be represented per species/zone/licence; F2-F4 and AUTRE cannot coexist.
recommended_action: Add a quality field or versioned product variants (e.g. sawlog_f1) before full ingestion.

issue: Harvest cost is an equation, not a zone rate.
evidence: tbl_Equations_Recolte (45 rows) and tbl_Profil_Rentabilite_EqGraph (30 rows) use m3/tige, cutting mode and stand type.
impact: No single harvest CAD/m3 to book; sample only has loading (2.80).
recommended_action: Derive a volume/tige distribution per zone/stratum, or obtain FPInterface/contractor actuals.

issue: Many treatment rates are per 1,000 plants or microsites, not per ha.
evidence: tbl_Liste_Traitements: 40 DolHa, 19 Dol1000Plants, 1 Dol1000Micro, 34 harvest treatments without a rate.
impact: Cannot convert to CAD/ha or CAD/m3 without density/yield.
recommended_action: Add plants/ha, microsites/ha and yield (m3/ha) to the conversion layer.

issue: Tertiary road construction is CAD/ha; ledger only allows CAD_per_ha for silviculture.
impact: Road cost is understated if the tertiary component is omitted.
recommended_action: Convert at a documented m3/ha yield, or extend the schema to allow CAD_per_ha for road.

issue: Tarification zones (191) are not UAs or administrative regions.
evidence: tbl_Liste_ZonesRedev has only Zone_Redev and Secteur; no UA/region name in the DB.
impact: Cannot join to QC-UA harvest allocation without a crosswalk.
recommended_action: Obtain the BMMB tarification-zone to UA/region crosswalk.

issue: MERIS is an analysis tool, not a register of actual permit volumes.
evidence: tbl_Volume_Prescription=0 rows; tbl_unifiee_assigne_zones=1; tbl_unifiee_assigne_traitements=1; no harvest-declaration table.
impact: Coverage shares and volume weighting cannot be computed from MERIS alone.
recommended_action: Join to BMMB sales, CAAF/permit or NFD volume data.

issue: Current rates and economic values use different years and bases.
impact: Mixing them would double count or compare nominal 2025 with real 2023.
recommended_action: Keep year=2025 nominal and year=2023 CAD_real_2023 separate; deflate only in a derived view.

issue: Bnf, Rsl and Aut1 are factor incomes/policy adjustments, not ledger components.
evidence: MERIS_Aide.doc §4.8.1: Rdv=redevance tendance, Bnf=profit of harvest/processing firms, Rsl=labour rent, Aut1=CPRS 25 $/m3 adjustment, Tot=sum.
impact: Mapping Bnf/Rsl to revenue or cost would double count value added.
recommended_action: Report as a separate economic-value decomposition, never in the ledger.

evidence: All 191 rows lack a date; DB release is 2025-09-23.
impact: Cost values may be older than 2025.
recommended_action: Confirm the survey year with BMMB; until then label price_year_basis=db_release_2025-09-23.

issue: mdb-schema 1.0.0 fails on the ACCDB backend.
evidence: mdb-schema MERIS_BdTbl.accdb <table> returns "Invalid backend type"; mdb-tables/mdb-count/mdb-export work.
impact: Field types and indexes are inferred from export headers, not declared schema.
recommended_action: Use Access/Jackcess or the ACCDB metadata if exact types are required; data extraction is unaffected.

issue: tbl_essences_revenus_EssDhp is not usable as a price table in this release.
evidence: All 1,824 SCIAGE and PATE values are 0.0100 in both courant and tendance rows.
impact: Do not use as a revenue source; would understate revenue by four orders of magnitude.
recommended_action: Treat as a placeholder; obtain the real value matrix or BMMB sale data.

issue: MERIS admin_dol_m3 is operator administration, not the Crown annual rent/licence fee.
evidence: MERIS_Aide.doc §4.5.5 lists administration among supply costs; no Crown rent field in tbl_couts_zones.
impact: Mapping it to admin_fee would misstate Crown revenue.
recommended_action: Map to overhead; obtain separate Crown rent/invoice data for admin_fee.

issue: Sample is one zone (151) plus raw rows for 151/192/888.
evidence: 191 zones exist; sample covers 1.6% of zones.
recommended_action: Full extraction can export all 191 zones once the schema gaps are resolved.
